stories.title: CISA Flags Two Actively Exploited Critical Flaws in Collabora Online and Arista VeloCloud
stories.abstract: CISA has added two critical vulnerabilities to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog: an OS command injection flaw in Collabora Online's CODE Server and a SQL injection vulnerability affecting Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator. Both are currently being leveraged by threat actors in the wild.
stories.why: These flaws allow for unauthorized system control, making them high-priority targets for attackers seeking to compromise enterprise infrastructure.
stories.action: Apply the latest security patches for Collabora Online and Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator immediately.

stories.title: PHP2Shell Exploit Attempts Hit Millions as Attackers Try to Deploy Mirai Malware
stories.abstract: Two critical use-after-free vulnerabilities in PHP, tracked as CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619, are currently being targeted by threat actors. While initial exploitation attempts to integrate systems into the Potassium botnet have struggled, the flaws allow for unauthenticated remote code execution.
stories.why: These vulnerabilities carry high CVSS scores and pose a significant risk of remote code execution across widely deployed web server and CMS infrastructure.
stories.action: Update PHP to the latest patched version immediately.

BlackX UEFI Bootkit Bypasses Secure Boot on Patched Windows Systems Missing Revocations
stories.abstract: A China-linked threat actor, likely APT41, is deploying the BlackX UEFI bootkit against diplomatic targets in Central Asia. The malware leverages the Baton Drop vulnerability to circumvent Secure Boot, allowing it to disable security software from Kaspersky and Avast at the firmware level.
stories.why: Firmware-level persistence is notoriously difficult to detect and remediate, granting attackers deep, long-term control over compromised systems.
stories.action: Ensure all firmware is updated and Secure Boot is correctly configured with current revocation lists.
